name: eduvia-consultancy
description: Eduvia Consultancy Pvt. Ltd. — study abroad consultancy website (React frontend + Express/PostgreSQL backend)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,red "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
